pages.text: Combat traits come in two kinds: $(bold)material default traits$() (innate to the core material, triggering in techniques and domain attacks as usual) and $(bold)general enhancement traits$() (added through crystals/rituals).$(br2)$(bold)Material default traits$():$(li)$(l:trait_child_of_the_stars)Child of the Stars$() (Ashen Ink): final damage x2^level$(li)$(l:trait_cosmic_order_voice)Cosmic Order Voice$() (Gheloth Remains): hits slow / blind$(li)$(l:trait_dragonsteel_fire)Fire Dragonsteel$() (Dragonsteel Fire): hits explode and ignite$(li)$(l:trait_dragonsteel_ice)Ice Dragonsteel$() (Dragonsteel Ice): hits freeze$(li)$(l:trait_dragonsteel_lightning)Lightning Dragonsteel$() (Dragonsteel Lightning): hits call down disarming lightning$(li)$(l:trait_dreadsteel)Dreadsteel$() (Dreadsteel): piercing slash + weakness / blindness / wither$(li)$(l:trait_hastur_malice)Howling Wind$() (Hastur's Malice): wind field pulls and damages$(li)$(l:trait_charm)Charm$() (Life Impulse): charmed targets cannot attack$(li)$(l:trait_dragonbone)Carrying$() (Dragonbone): dragonsteel traits +1 level$(li)$(l:trait_dragon_blood_tank)Dragon Blood Tank$() (Dragonbone): stores three dragon bloods$(li)$(l:trait_unbreakable)Unbreakable$() (Durandal): the tool never breaks$(li)$(l:trait_cold_blooded)Cold-Blooded$() (Formless Ice): extra ice spell damage after a hit$(li)$(l:trait_endless_cold_wind)Endless Cold Wind$() (Formless Ice): +50% ice spell power while held$(li)$(l:trait_blazing)Blazing$() (Pyrium): chance to ignite + extra fire spell damage$(li)$(l:trait_holy_war_relic)Holy War Relic$() (Pyrium): +1 upgrade / +1 defense / +2 ability slots$(li)$(l:trait_magic_conduction)Magic Conduction$() (Arcane Iron): magic damage reduction, stacks per piece$(li)$(l:trait_focus)Focus$() (Mithril): casting cannot be interrupted + 5% cast speed per level$(li)$(l:trait_spell_break)Spell Break$() (Mithril): comes with a level 1 Counterspell$(li)$(l:trait_super_tier_magic)Super-Tier Magic$() (Magic Gold): tools take inscriptions, spells are cast at twice their own level cap with 3x range / 2x duration$(li)$(l:trait_arcane_domination)Arcane Domination$() (Magic Gold): all schools +100% spell power$(li)$(l:trait_inscription)Inscription$() (Hogskin): while held or worn, spell power +10% per piece$(li)$(l:trait_biting_frost)Biting Frost$() (Frozen Bone): hits freeze the enemy for 3 x level seconds, 6s cooldown$(li)$(l:trait_origin_magic)Origin Magic$() (Origin Alloy): all spells +2 x level, eldritch needs no learning$(li)$(l:trait_chaos_flow)Chaos Flow$() (Origin Alloy): each attack rolls physical or one random school's spell damage (single instance; never the same type 3 times in a row)$(li)$(l:trait_order_origin)Order of Origin$() (Origin Alloy armor): incoming damage recast as physical

$(bold)General enhancement traits$():$(li)$(l:trait_all_spells_unity)Myriad Spells as One$() (Magic Gold): highest single piece gives +100 max mana per level, plus Echoing Strikes and Abyssal Shroud gifts$(li)$(l:trait_nyarlathotep_desire)Nyarlathotep's Desire$(): +1 ability slot per level$(li)$(l:trait_yog_sothoth_gift)Gift of Time and Space$(): +500% experience$(li)$(l:trait_black_flash)Black Flash$(): chance for a burst of massive damage$(li)$(l:trait_west_tiger)West Tiger$(): raises the Black Flash trigger rate$(li)$(l:trait_lucky_drop)Greed$(): extra loot drops$(li)$(l:trait_gorgon_immunity)Mind's Eye$(): immunity to petrifying gazes$(li)$(l:trait_fus_ro_dah)Fus-Ro-Dah$(): hits send targets flying$(li)$(l:trait_ghost_clearing)Atheist$(): clears ghosts$(li)$(l:trait_dragon_blood_infusion)Dragon Blood Infusion$(): dragon blood applies status effects$(li)$(l:trait_chaos_butterfly)Chaos Butterfly$(): the war scythe's Fever mechanic$(li)$(l:trait_quantum_bag)Quantum Bag$(): a pocket dimension you carry along$(br2)$(bold)Armor-exclusive traits$() (not applicable to cores):$(li)$(l:trait_mana_armor)Mana Armor$() (Magic Gold): every 100 max mana grants 0.5 damage reduction, stacking$(li)$(l:trait_star_child_armor)Child of the Stars (Armor)$()$(li)$(l:trait_dragonsteel_fire_armor)Fire Dragon Scales$() / $(l:trait_dragonsteel_ice_armor)Ice Dragon Scales$() / $(l:trait_dragonsteel_lightning_armor)Lightning Dragon Scales$()$(li)$(l:trait_dreadsteel_armor)Dreadsteel Armament$()$(li)$(l:trait_ancient_sanctuary)Ancient Sanctuary$()
